limits: Everything here follows from what the host wrote. Discrimination is computed from the predicted values given, so a wrong prediction produces a wrong separation.
Two predictions differ only when their values differ. Wording is never compared, and two readouts named differently are treated as different readouts.
Evidence roles and readings are the host's interpretation. Counting studies says how many papers were cited, not that any of them supports the claim.
Mechanism links are case candidates. A graph path means the curated graph holds a route between two exactly-matched entities; it says nothing about this case's conditions.
Nothing here ranks experiments. Which to run first is the host's argument and the researcher's decision.

Two hypotheses predicting different values on a readout is not a measure of how well the experiment would discriminate them, and says nothing about separating causes acting together: effect size, noise and interference are not modelled.
A state (present/absent) and a change (increase/decrease/no_change) are different claims and are never compared; neither are two changes stated against different references.
Prediction traces follow the references the host gave. A connected path is not a verified causal chain.

goal_trace.statement: Decide whether the persisting phenotype requires ongoing TGF-beta receptor input after washout.
If input is required, identify its source: carried-over exogenous ligand, matrix latent TGF-beta, or cell-secreted factors.
Test cell-intrinsic routes: chromatin/TF memory, senescence, and mechanical self-reinforcement including substrate stiffness.
Determine whether persistence is a per-cell state change or a change in population composition.
Establish that the readouts measure what they are taken to measure: ligand detection limit, blocker efficacy, alpha-SMA protein turnover.
Determine which interventions reverse the phenotype and on what timescale.

host_readings: Establishes the induction leg: TGF-beta1 on plastic gives alpha-SMA-positive, near-non-proliferating myofibroblasts with 4-fold gel contraction.
Strain release depolymerised stress fibres in both myofibroblast types, so a fibre readout can fall for purely mechanical reasons.
Magnetic posts both measure and set tension, which is why this plan quantifies traction instead of inferring it from alpha-SMA.
Valvular interstitial cells, fibrin micro-tissues, mechanical stimulus: it cannot say whether a TGF-beta1 pulse leaves an intrinsic state.
Cancer-associated fibroblasts with a stiffness trigger; normal fibroblasts after a TGF-beta1 pulse are a different case.
Mesenchymal stromal cells primed by stiffness, not fibroblasts pulsed with TGF-beta1.
Neonatal rat cells, 7 days, dose printed garbled: neither dose nor duration transfers to a 48-72 h human pulse.
Diseased palmar fibroblasts, no washout design, and no measurement of residual exogenous ligand.
HGF interfering with TGF-beta1 signalling gives an orthogonal pharmacological handle on the autocrine leg.
Patient ILD fibroblasts, already fibrotic; a normal fibroblast after a pulse need not run the same loop.
Host reading: if stiffness alone holds a contractile phenotype, a plastic culture can look persistent with no memory of treatment.
Neither the fibroblast type nor the stiffness range is stated, so the soft-gel stiffness chosen here is an assumption.
